query:
UPDATE users SET erase_started_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = (
            SELECT id FROM users
            WHERE delete_after <= NOW()
              AND (erase_started_at IS NULL OR erase_started_at < NOW() - make_interval(secs => $1))
            ORDER BY delete_after
            LIMIT 1
            FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
        )
        RETURNING id
